why_useful: Supporting library for the strr/ghost/raffle ecosystem; only useful in combination with those.
themes: University and municipal research datasets on STRs published on GitHub (city planning departments, urban labs, McGill UPGo, Inside Airbnb collaborators)

wildcard: a regulator/compliance analyst tracking STR ordinances, regi

Supporting tooling for the same AirDNA/STR pipeline as strr; low standalone value but worth noting alongside strr since some strr functions may depend on it.

name: mobilib
what_it_holds: Python library (MIT, 81 commits) for processing mobile-positioning data into commuting-interaction matrices, hierarchical settlement models, and functional-region delimitation. No mobile-operator or tourism data is committed; it is a processing toolkit to apply to an MNO dataset a team already holds.
why_useful: A ready-made method for turning raw mobile-positioning data into origin-destination flows, directly applicable if the team obtains an MNO/Eurostat-experimental tourism panel later; useful as tooling rather than as a dataset.
themes: Electricity, water and waste data as occupancy proxies (smart-meter open data, tourist-area utility consumption), and mobile-phone tourism statistics (Eurostat MNO experimental)
why_all: A ready-made method for turning raw mobile-positioning data into origin-destination flows, directly applicable if the team obtains an MNO/Eurostat-experimental tourism panel later; useful as tooling rather than as a dataset.
General-purpose method library for turning raw mobile-positioning feeds into interpretable mobility/OD statistics; relevant if the team obtains any MNO-derived feed for a tourism market.

name: MPDSamplingStatistics
what_it_holds: A program for comparing different Mobile Positioning Data (MPD)-based results against each other with statistical tests — companion tool to SynthMPDGenerator from the same Estonian mobility-lab ecosystem underlying Eurostat's MNO tourism-statistics pilot.
why_useful: Marginal: a validation-methodology tool for MPD-derived statistics (the same family as Eurostat MNO experimental tourism stats), useful only if the team acquires raw MPD panels to cross-check.
themes: Electricity, water and waste data as occupancy proxies (smart-meter open data, tourist-area utility consumption), and mobile-phone tourism statistics (Eurostat MNO experimental)
why_all: Marginal: a validation-methodology tool for MPD-derived statistics (the same family as Eurostat MNO experimental tourism stats), useful only if the team acquires raw MPD panels to cross-check.
Methodological reference for validating any MNO-derived tourism/mobility proxy the team might build; no data itself.
